subject: math

objective.text: Find 1, 10 and 100 thousand more and less than a number.

explanations.title: 1 thousand more or less
explanations.text: To find 1 thousand more, add 1 to the thousands digit. To find 1 thousand less, take 1 from it. The other digits stay the same.

explanations.title: 10 thousand more or less
explanations.text: 10 thousand is 1 ten thousand. Change the ten thousands digit by 1. The other digits stay the same.

explanations.title: 100 thousand more or less
explanations.text: 100 thousand is 1 hundred thousand. Change the hundred thousands digit by 1. The other digits stay the same.

explanations.title: Patterns in place value
explanations.text: In a pattern like 545,000, 445,000, 345,000 only one unit changes. Here the hundred thousands decrease by 1 each time.

explanations.title: Numbers in units
explanations.text: 54,783 is 54 thousands 783 ones. It is also 5 ten thousands 47 hundreds 83 ones.

examples.title: 1 thousand more and less than 3,112
examples.text: 1 thousand more than 3,112 is 4,112. 1 thousand less is 2,112.

hints.text: Count by the unit. Say the number of units, then say the number.
Split the number at the unit. Count the units on the left and the ones on the right.
Compare the largest unit first. Then compare the next place.
Use each digit once. Put big digits in the largest places for the greatest number.
Change only the thousands digit by 1. Keep the other digits.
Change only the ten thousands digit by 1. Keep the other digits.
Change only the hundred thousands digit by 1. Keep the other digits.
Write the number in standard form first. Then find more or less.
Find the difference between the two numbers. Think of which unit is different.
Decide if the story adds or takes away. Then use the number.
Look at which digit changes. Find how it changes each time.

assets_required.interaction: Child picks an amount and more or less. The chart changes one digit and shows the new number.
assets_required.alt_text: A place value chart with a number and the changed digit highlighted.
